title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Enhanced demo data for sales, purchasing, and fixed assets analytics
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 1 (BC28) enhances demo data for sales, purchasing, and fixed assets modules to improve reporting and analytics demonstrations. The enhancements include more salespeople, open orders, backorders, deferral codes, discounts, purchasing dimensions, and fixed asset dimensions.
key_points: Sales demo data now includes distributed salespeople, expanded open orders and backorders, spread-out due dates, deferral codes, and line discounts
Purchasing enhancements add a new purchasing department dimension and purchaser/return reason information to both purchase documents and analytics
Fixed assets demo data now includes dimension setup and posted entries for better demonstration of fixed asset analytics
features: Enhanced demo data for fixed assets

quotes.text: In Business Central 2024 wave 2 (BC25.3), the method of creating demo/sample data using Configuration packages was deprecated.
quotes.why_it_matters: Important context that the old Configuration package method for demo data creation is no longer supported.
